249	  /**
250	   * Compact for replayed step-boundary pressure or one provider-confirmed context
251	   * overflow. Both triggers price the latest durable routed request envelope;
252	   * overflow bypasses the normal threshold and retained-tail policy so it can
253	   * force one useful balanced reduction.
254	   * @param agent - agent whose latest durable routed request is measured.
255	   * @param trigger - normal step-boundary pressure or context-overflow recovery.
256	   * @param signal - live turn cancellation signal forwarded to summarization.
257	   * @returns the latest summary compaction result, or `null` when no summary ran.
258	   */
259	  override async compactIfNeeded(
260	    agent: Agent,
261	    trigger: CompactionTrigger,
262	    signal: AbortSignal,
263	  ): Promise<CompactionResult | null> {
264	    const target = routedTarget(agent.session)
265	    if (target === undefined) return null
266	    const policy = resolveTargetPolicy(this.config, target)
267	    const meter = this.ctx.tokenMeter
268	    let measurement = meter.measure(agent.session)
269	    switch (trigger) {
270	      case 'context-overflow':
271	        break
272	      case 'pressure':
273	        break
274	      /* v8 ignore next -- closed-union exhaustiveness guard */
275	      default:
276	        assertNever(trigger, 'compaction trigger')
277	    }
278	
279	    // Pruning is optional so compaction-basic remains independently composable.
280	    // Overflow always qualifies; pressure first resolves the routed model's
281	    // capacity and checks its target-specific threshold.
282	    const prune = this.ctx.get('toolResultPruner')
283	
284	    if (trigger === 'context-overflow') {
285	      if (prune !== undefined) {
286	        prune.pruneSession(agent.session)
287	        measurement = meter.measure(agent.session)
288	      }
